canonical_logo_placement.description: Exact placement of the original thigh decal. Every logo option defaults here; the game UI can reposition/resize/rotate or snap back to this.
canonical_logo_placement.notes: Both thighs share this UV region (mirrored), so one placement covers both legs.

coordinate_system.pixel_space: x right, y DOWN, origin top-left of the PNG as stored in the GLB
coordinate_system.uv_space: u = x/512, v = y/512 (same origin as pixel space for compositing)

entries.name: Pantera logo — white scratch marks
entries.notes: The ORIGINAL thigh decal: black leaping panther with white scratch marks, extracted from the Attire 3 tights texture. Transparent background.

entries.name: Pantera logo — red scratch marks
entries.notes: Variant: black panther, scratch marks recolored red. Same placement, drop-in swap.

entries.name: Pantera logo — snow leopard
entries.notes: Owner-supplied snow leopard artwork (2026-10-17), blue background keyed to transparent. CURRENTLY APPLIED on Attire 3 tights.
entries.placement_mode: contain-fit centered in canonical rect (186x186 at rect center)

entries.name: Tights — blue (snow leopard attire)
entries.notes: Full blue tights texture WITH the snow leopard thigh decal baked in — the current Attire 3 state. Re-apply whole, or use tights-blue-clean + a logo option.

entries.name: Tights — blue, clean (no thigh logo)
entries.notes: Neutral base: blue tights with the logo area restored to clean fabric. Composite any logo option onto this, then re-embed.

entries.name: Pants — black trunks
entries.notes: Black trunks texture (Modelpants_Material027 baseColor), PANTERA chest/trunks logo included.

how_to_swap: 2. Composite it into King_PantsLower_D at canonical_logo_placement.pixel_rect (contain-fit, centered) — or at custom x/y/scale/rotation from the game UI.
3. Re-embed the texture as image 44 (Modelthighs_Material029 baseColor) in roster/pantera/attires/snow-leopard/pantera-snow-leopard.glb.
4. To restore the original exactly: composite pantera-logo-white-scratches.png at the canonical rect.
source: Owner directive 2026-10-17: save thigh decals + tights/pants as interchangeable customization options, WWE/Tekken-style.
